stories.title: Nasdaq surges nearly 7% as Huang's return to Nvidia revives AI trade
stories.summary: The Nasdaq Composite jumped nearly 7%. Reports say Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returned to the company. The news revived investor demand for AI stocks. The source did not explain why Huang had been away.
stories.whyItMatters: Nvidia drives the AI trade. A move this large shows how much the market depends on Nvidia's leadership.
whatToWatch: Nvidia's stock price in coming sessions.
An official statement from Nvidia about Huang's status.
questions: Why did Huang return, and where was he before?
Did the rally lift other AI-linked stocks too?

stories.title: Medifast director buys $77,610 in company stock
stories.summary: Medifast director Parsa Kiai bought $77,610 in company stock. The purchase appears in a regulatory filing cited by Investing.com. Investors track insider buys like this as a sign of confidence. The report gave no other details on share count or price.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider purchases can signal that a director believes the stock is undervalued.

stories.title: Trian presses Solventum to spin off health information unit
stories.summary: Activist investor Nelson Peltz's Trian Partners wants Solventum to spin off its health information unit. Trian will drop the demand only if a sale of the unit beats its expected price range. The report did not give the price range or deal terms.
stories.whyItMatters: Activist pressure like this can force a company breakup or sale. That changes value for Solventum shareholders.
whatToWatch: Any sale process update or spinoff announcement.
questions: What price range is Trian using as its benchmark?
Will Solventum's board agree to a spinoff?

stories.title: India's rupee carry trade holds on RBI support, but risks build

stories.whyItMatters: Carry trades that depend on central bank support can unwind fast if that support changes. Currency and rates investors watch this closely.
whatToWatch: Any change in RBI's intervention stance.
Moves in the rupee's exchange rate.

stories.title: Oil falls about 3% on higher Middle East flows, Libyan pipeline restart

stories.whyItMatters: Oil price moves of this size affect energy stocks, inflation expectations, and consumer costs.
whatToWatch: Whether the Libyan pipeline restart holds.
Further supply signals from Middle East producers or OPEC+.
